approval_required_for: Any architecture, pipeline-semantics, memory-layout, or major template change.
Any change to the immutable checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, generated golden, numeric comparison policy, tolerance, or Transformer-block-only functional boundary.
Any modification or substitution of the exact user-supplied board wrapper, Vivado export/source identity, or board target when discovery evidence is ambiguous.

consumes: current case-adapter target checkpoint and complete target-layer Transformer-block tensor inventory
immutable board-scope stimulus provenance and target-model reference contract
immutable numeric comparison policy, using only current values or frozen framework defaults for absent fields
current case_board_interface_discovery exact user-supplied wrapper/source identity and Vivado export facts
active SACG trust barriers and open retry requests as non-validating planning inputs
executable_actions.on_failure: Keep all SACG barriers and retries active, do not invoke VCS or any backend tool, and do not alter the checkpoint, stimulus, target reference, numeric policy, generated golden, exact wrapper, or wrapper-source hashes. If exact board-source discovery or compile authority is ambiguous, stop rather than guessing a wrapper or executable and request bounded approval for a cited source-identity decision. If the fresh multilayer gate still fails, retain the concrete failed binding/harness delta for another bounded verification-capability repair; do not diagnose RTL or reopen lower layers.
executable_actions.rationale: Repair the actual earliest failure before requesting hardware localization: create a fresh, hash-bound board verification candidate that proves complete Transformer-block weight coverage and provides the missing generated board testbench. The existing ready_to_apply source-identity rebind may be applied only if preflight proves it targets a declared editable testbench source at its current hash; it is not accepted as a complete repair without fresh gate results.

consumes: exact board-wrapper and Vivado-export source hashes
validated lower-layer certificate identities and elastic-pipeline timing invariants
executable_actions.on_failure: Treat a failed replay as current-layer evidence only. Localize the earliest violated board wrapper, loader, AXI/DDR, scheduler, data-order, or lifecycle boundary and repair that bounded integration slice. Do not interpret prefetch/AXI progress as output progress and do not require same-cycle unequal-latency kernel stages. Reopen a lower layer only if the new hash-bound trace directly contradicts a named lower-layer invariant and includes direct core-start, ingress, egress, named causal-boundary, and current-certificate evidence; otherwise retain both lower certificates and request no backtrack.
executable_actions.rationale: Once the static multilayer binding gate passes, obtain fresh board-scope tool evidence rather than relying on the historical unbound analyzer record. The replay must bind the exact wrapper and compile plan, execute the same immutable model reference/stimulus contract, prove actual required-weight consumption, and collect the current output/lifecycle frontier plus causal-boundary evidence.

consumes: active SACG contamination barriers and open retry requests
executable_actions.on_failure: Remain at board_axi_ddr_wrapped_system, preserve all current barriers and retries as downstream-consumption blockers, and return the failed report plus current causal context to bounded Stage8 repair. Do not promote to synthesis, implementation, bitstream, runtime ABI, or board runtime. Do not close or supersede retry/barrier records absent a fully passing current Stage7 candidate and an authorized reconciliation result.
executable_actions.rationale: A board candidate can be considered only after the real replay and every dependent Stage7 gate pass. This action completes the board functional, liveness, protocol, DDR-image, and semantic-evidence checks and records the resulting candidate without prematurely clearing active contamination barriers or retry requests.

observations: real_tool.case_multilayer_pipeline is the authoritative earliest executed current-layer failure. Its reported blockers are absent complete Transformer-block tensor-to-loader-to-DUT binding for every target layer and absent hash-verified multilayer harness sources.

The functional simulation failure is a precondition/dependency failure: verification/board_simulation/board_tb.sv is missing, while VCS, its analyzer, AXI/deadlock diagnostics, and downstream functional gates are not_run. It is not evidence of an RTL output, AXI, DDR, numeric, or liveness defect.

The ready_to_apply prior repair-execution record is only a simulation-source identity rebind candidate. It is not passing evidence and cannot by itself establish complete weight consumption, a target-model golden, or functional correctness; it must be preflighted and rechecked in a fresh candidate closure.

Historical VCS analyzer content reporting zero accepted output beats is explicitly historical_only because it lacks current source-bound applicability. It cannot select a kernel root cause or contradict lower-layer certificates.

The live lower-layer certificates remain reusable: operator-leaf certificate SHA-256 2bbc6880205155cbc1119882b2503281c2cb43b4b3c0d40a1754acb1e3a20569 and single-layer certificate SHA-256 44d3689d835f165fd30e794aeec2dabf648d1d65d17a24a53d3a6aac6e3854e7. There is no open backtrack request or current hash-bound trace contradicting either certificate.

Connected-kernel timing remains an elastic, variable-latency token-pipeline invariant: preserve certified boundary order and cross-token overlap; unequal per-stage start/end cycles are not a failure condition.

sacg_memory_truth has 10 active current-scope contamination barriers and four open current-scope retry requests (retry_request.0136, retry_request.0140, retry_request.0141, retry_request.0142). Rejected artifacts remain planning/debug inputs only; no retry-reconciliation contract or passing content-addressed board candidate is supplied.
proposed_actions: Preflight and materialize a new board verification candidate that binds the exact discovered board wrapper, immutable checkpoint/stimulus/reference/numeric policy, generated board_tb.sv, complete Transformer-block tensor catalog, and complete loader-to-DUT binding requirements. Preserve all model-tail exclusions and do not alter RTL, wrapper hashes, checkpoint, stimulus, golden, or tolerance.

Rerun case_multilayer_pipeline before simulation. Only after it passes, run case_axi_ddr_interface and the real board VCS replay with current source hashes, weight-consumption observations, and case-adapter-defined boundary monitors.

If VCS reports a real failure, use its fresh board trace to localize the earliest current-layer causal boundary. Repair only the loader/harness/wrapper integration slice unless the trace directly contradicts a named lower-layer certificate with core-start, ingress, egress, named-boundary, and current-certificate evidence.

After functional simulation passes, execute the remaining board gate DAG and semantic-evidence assembly, then write a SACG candidate/retry reconciliation record. Retain all existing barriers and retries until all selected Stage7 gates pass; do not promote to backend or board runtime.
risks: Model/shape/loader risk: a manifest may enumerate sampled or single-layer weights rather than every required Transformer-block tensor in every target layer, or may include excluded embedding, final norm, LM-head/logit, or sampling tensors. Neither outcome proves required DUT coverage.

Numeric/reference risk: expected outputs must come from a real target-model inference on the identical immutable checkpoint and stimulus. The numeric policy may only use its current resolved values or frozen framework defaults for absent fields, never values inferred from RTL output.

Data-order/memory/runtime risk: tensor layout, layer order, addresses, transfer counts, and AXI/DDR image ordering can disagree even if files exist. Independent prefetch or AXI movement is not output/lifecycle-frontier progress.

Implementation/board risk: board_tb.sv, VCS compile authority, and source-identity evidence must bind the exact user-supplied wrapper and Vivado export facts. A simplified wrapper, guessed source target, changed wrapper hash, or unauthorized executable invalidates board evidence.

Trust-boundary risk: the active SACG barriers and retries prevent downstream consumption and promotion. A new candidate may be created, but old failed artifacts must not be relabeled as validated and lower-layer evidence must not be reopened without the required current contradiction.
output.summary: Keep board_axi_ddr_wrapped_system fail-closed. The earliest executed current-scope failure is case_multilayer_pipeline: all-target-layer Transformer-block weight binding and hash-verified multilayer harness sources are absent; board_tb.sv is also absent, so functional_sim is dependency-unsatisfied rather than RTL, AXI, DDR, numeric, or liveness evidence. Repair the board-scope verification capability first, then run a hash-bound board trace and only then localize any real hardware failure; do not reopen certified leaf or connected-kernel scopes or promote to backend/board runtime.
